concepts.proposed_markdown: For POS, Adyen distinguishes platform-generated Standard transaction webhooks from platform-generated terminal-management webhooks for assignment, boarding, orders, and settings. Standard webhook event codes and optional `additionalData` are configured separately; terminal-management payloads have another structure and need only the Customer Area server/security configuration described by the guide. These backend platform webhooks are distinct from terminal-generated EventNotification and DisplayRequest messages and from an immediate Terminal API payment response.
warnings: Do not apply Standard webhook `additionalData` fields or event-code configuration to terminal-management payloads, or conflate platform webhooks with terminal-generated messages.
